conditions.name: Common Cold
conditions.description: A viral infection of the upper respiratory tract. Usually resolves on its own within 7-10 days.
conditions.recommended_action: Rest, stay hydrated, and use over-the-counter remedies for symptom relief.
home_care_tips: Drink plenty of fluids (water, herbal tea, broth)
Get adequate rest
Use saline nasal spray for congestion
Gargle warm salt water for sore throat

conditions.name: Influenza (Flu)
conditions.description: A contagious respiratory illness caused by influenza viruses. More severe than the common cold.
conditions.recommended_action: Rest, hydrate, and consider antiviral medication if caught early. Avoid contact with others.
home_care_tips: Stay home and rest
Take fever-reducing medication (acetaminophen or ibuprofen)
Drink lots of fluids
Use a humidifier

conditions.name: Migraine
conditions.description: A neurological condition causing intense, debilitating headaches often accompanied by sensory disturbances.
conditions.recommended_action: Rest in a quiet, dark room. Take prescribed or OTC migraine medication at onset.
see_doctor_if: Headache with fever and stiff neck
home_care_tips: Lie down in a dark, quiet room
Apply cold or warm compress to head/neck
Stay hydrated
Avoid known triggers (bright lights, strong smells)

conditions.name: Gastroenteritis (Stomach Flu)
conditions.description: Inflammation of the stomach and intestines, usually caused by a viral or bacterial infection.
conditions.recommended_action: Focus on staying hydrated. Eat bland foods once you can tolerate them. Rest.
see_doctor_if: Signs of dehydration (dry mouth, no urination, dizziness)
home_care_tips: Sip clear fluids frequently (water, broth, electrolyte drinks)
Follow the BRAT diet (Bananas, Rice, Applesauce, Toast)
Avoid dairy, fatty, and spicy foods
Rest as much as possible

conditions.name: Allergic Rhinitis
conditions.description: An allergic response causing cold-like symptoms triggered by allergens such as pollen, dust mites, or pet dander.
conditions.recommended_action: Avoid known allergens. Antihistamines and nasal corticosteroids can provide relief.
see_doctor_if: Symptoms significantly affecting quality of life
home_care_tips: Keep windows closed during high-pollen seasons
Use air purifiers indoors
Shower after outdoor activities
Wear sunglasses outdoors to protect eyes

conditions.name: Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)
conditions.description: A bacterial infection affecting any part of the urinary system. More common in women.
conditions.recommended_action: See a doctor promptly for antibiotic treatment. Drink plenty of water.
see_doctor_if: Back or side pain (possible kidney infection)
Symptoms not improving after 2 days of antibiotics
home_care_tips: Drink plenty of water to flush bacteria
Avoid caffeine, alcohol, and spicy foods
Use a heating pad on your abdomen
Do not delay seeing a doctor — antibiotics are usually required

conditions.name: Hypertensive Crisis
conditions.description: A sudden, severe increase in blood pressure that can lead to stroke or heart attack if untreated.
conditions.recommended_action: CALL 911 OR GO TO THE EMERGENCY ROOM IMMEDIATELY. This is a medical emergency.
see_doctor_if: Any of these symptoms — go to ER immediately
home_care_tips: Do NOT wait — seek emergency care immediately
Do not drive yourself
Call 911

conditions.name: Anxiety / Panic Attack
conditions.description: Intense episodes of fear or discomfort that trigger severe physical reactions. Can mimic heart attack.
conditions.recommended_action: Practice deep breathing and grounding techniques. Seek mental health support.
see_doctor_if: First time experiencing these symptoms (rule out cardiac cause)
Unable to function in daily life
home_care_tips: Practice 4-7-8 breathing (inhale 4s, hold 7s, exhale 8s)
Ground yourself using the 5-4-3-2-1 technique
Move to a quiet, calm space
Remind yourself the attack will pass

conditions.name: Appendicitis
matching_symptoms: pain around navel moving to lower right
conditions.description: Inflammation of the appendix. Requires urgent surgical treatment.
conditions.recommended_action: GO TO THE EMERGENCY ROOM IMMEDIATELY. Do not eat or drink anything.
see_doctor_if: Any suspicion of appendicitis — go to ER immediately
home_care_tips: Do not take pain medication before being evaluated — it can mask symptoms
Do not apply heat to the abdomen
Call 911 or go to the ER immediately

conditions.name: Type 2 Diabetes (Hyperglycemia episode)
conditions.description: Symptoms may indicate uncontrolled blood sugar. Requires medical evaluation and lifestyle management.
conditions.recommended_action: Schedule an appointment with your doctor for blood glucose testing.
see_doctor_if: Rapid breathing — these indicate diabetic ketoacidosis, a medical emergency
home_care_tips: Monitor blood sugar if you have a glucometer
Stay hydrated
Avoid sugary foods and drinks
Contact your doctor promptly
